title: Labour-migration panel
description: Tidy, audited extraction of the labour-approval tables published by the Department of Foreign Employment: how many Nepalis received work permits, to which country or district, through which channel, in which fiscal year. Every source document is math-audited against its own printed totals before its rows enter the panel.
grain: one row per source document × reporting period × section (country | district) × entity × channel × gender

coverage.note: Bikram Sambat fiscal years (Shrawan–Ashad); archive backfill beyond this range is tracked separately in panel_archive_build.json

artifacts.description: Additive-only detail rows with canonical entities/channels/fiscal years; filter analysis_safe=true for the default specification.
Printed totals, aggregates and distinct measures — compare against, never add to the primary.
Raw tidy-long extraction exactly as emitted from the source tables.
Deaths, returns and remittance series — different units and bases from the panel.
Archive backfill of pre-2025 DoFE reports; not yet merged into the primary panel.
Archive rows whose entities or channels remain unresolved.

verification.method: per-document math audit of the extracted tables, reconciliation against printed totals, cross-source crosscheck against opendatanepal, gold-page transcription tests

notes: panel_archive*.csv.gz are fingerprinted only by counts in panel_archive_build.json — no SHA-256 is recorded for them yet.
